youtube.baslik: Which tone goes into the ear canal during tympanometry? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In tympanometry, a continuous probe tone is played into the ear canal; in adults, this tone is usually 226 Hz. In infants under six months, a 1000 Hz probe tone is preferred.
